_comment: One source of truth for week 4's rubric. The grader scores from this file, the homework's grading table is copied from it, and you can read it. If a number changes it changes HERE first. NOTE: from week 4 the graded repo is the PROJECT repo, not the coursework repo — the coursework repo is still swept for hygiene and holds the (ungraded) lab.

Check1_YouPickedATopic.label: Registry.Topic says what your project is about — in words, and not the example

Check2_YourRecordKeepsItsDataToItself.label: Your record has no public fields and at least 3 properties — week 3's shape, closed

Check3_SomethingRefusesABadValue.label: At least one property turns away a nonsense value instead of storing it

Check4_OnlyYourCodeCanChangeIt.label: At least one property the outside world can read and cannot write

Check5_TheRegistryHoldsRecords.label: Registry keeps records — Count asks the list, and All() hands back a copy

repoReachable.label: Public project repo exists at the URL you submitted, and clones

programRuns.label: The program builds and runs without crashing — even when fed nothing but Enter

gitignoreClean.label: bin/ and obj/ tracked in NEITHER repo — the .gitignore holding, in both places

commits.label: 3+ commits in the project repo 👀 (meaningful messages are a judgment call)

mergedPr.label: A merge commit on main — the branch → pull request → merge round trip, done once
